label: AbiL system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses a two-component AbiL-family locus represented by DefenseFinder as mandatory AbiL__AbiLi and AbiL__AbiLii profiles.
observations: AbiL branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual AbiL__AbiLi and AbiL__AbiLii profiles, accessory AbiLi2 and AbiLii2 HMM rows, the abiLi and abiLii genes, unresolved ATPase/TOPRIM predictions, PARIS mechanism comparisons, source database rows naming one AbiL model, and generic abortive infection systems.
